name: 参考樱花 02

parameters.prompt: One complete cherry blossom tree, matching the supplied isolated tree image. Reconstruct the ENTIRE DENSE FLOWERING CROWN as textured 3D blossom clusters connected to natural branching limbs. Preserve this reference tree silhouette, branch structure and flower color. Full detailed back and sides, realistic natural fine flower sprays suitable for a miniature Japanese town. Flowers must be abundant, not bare branches, not smooth spherical blobs. Bark visible on the lower trunk. Root flare meets ground at one point. No black background surface, no ground plate, grass, pedestal, sky, text, shadows baked into textures, or detached floating petals. Upright trunk and a dense broad rounded crown of very pale pink and ivory flowers.

imageProvider: User supplied sheet; deterministic crop and square padding, no image regeneration

inspection.notes: 繁密圆冠、浅粉偏白；后侧较紧凑。
inspection.limitation: Generated blossom clusters approximate the photographic fine flowers; not individual petals.

curation.reason: 树冠过于封闭和团块化，枝叶层次不清。
